essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: The Mechanism: Despair drives 'degeneracy'—relentless pursuit of new experiences when nothing internal can resolve confusion
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text: Despair sets in when you feel your life will never be clear. When confusion is everywhere you turn. Despair often leads to the relentless pursuit of new experiences, 'degeneracy', because people start thinking that nothing inside of them can resolve their confusion.

essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: Romeo's Constraint Theory: Agitation from overlaying present with past experiences creates intractable optimization
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text: If I'm agitated it's generally because I'm trying to feed my system too many constraints at once. Specifically, by overlaying my present experience with shades of past experiences, I am trying to find actions that make sense in all of them. This quickly turns intractable.
